notes.title: Mox3 bug crash fix - expanded
notes.content:
Fixed a define where Mox3 was causing games to crash. If you had this error, trying using a slightly earlier save and the problem should be fixed. 

If it persists, please copy+paste and report the issue so I can pin point your exact problem! Thank you.
